stories.title: Bring on the reinforcements! Returning players who could swing MLB's playoff races
stories.summary: These injured stars expected to come off the IL could prove as good as any trade deadline blockbuster.

stories.title: Greek team pursuing Jokic; made 'serious' offer
stories.summary: The owner of Panathinaikos Basketball Club in Athens, Greece, says he tried to buy Nikola Jokic out of his NBA contract for next season and believes he can sign the three-time MVP when he becomes a free agent next summer.

stories.title: Bieniemy back with Chiefs after wife's shooting
stories.summary: Chiefs offensive coordinator Eric Bieniemy returned to the team Monday after a two-week absence following the shooting of his wife. Bieniemy's son Elijah, 27, has been charged in the shooting.

stories.title: NCAA, FBI partner to fight athlete sexploitation
stories.summary: As college athletes become bigger targets for sexual exploitation online, the NCAA and FBI announced a partnership Monday to educate athletes on how to prevent private images from falling into the wrong hands.

stories.title: NFL to allow coach's designee to challenge calls
stories.summary: The NFL will allow head coaches to designate a member of their sideline staff to initiate replay challenges this season.
